findings.message: 5.1.2 Tracking SDK — IDFA/tracking signals detected (e.g. Mediation.swift) but no ATT prompt found; apps that track must request permission via AppTrackingTransparency (5.1.2)
export-compliance — Info.plist has no ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption; set it (true/false) to skip the App Store Connect encryption-export prompt every submission
2.3 Support URL — no non-empty support_url.txt in any locale under fastlane metadata; Apple requires a working support URL with developer contact info (1.5 / 2.3)
2.3 Privacy URL — no non-empty privacy_url.txt in any locale under fastlane metadata; a privacy policy link is required for every app, and especially apps with accounts or in-app purchases (5.1.1(i))

5.1.1 Privacy manifest — analytics SDK detected (e.g. Mediation.swift) but PrivacyInfo declares no collected data types or tracking domains; verify your privacy manifest and App Privacy nutrition labels
